{{Top|leg}}
A '''Solder-blaster''' was a type of tool that was commonly used in the repair of [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. A solder stick was used along with the tool.<ref name="DR">''[[Yoda: Dark Rendezvous]]''</ref>

[[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] [[Tallisibeth Enwandung-Esterhazy]] and [[Whie Malreaux/Legends|Whie Malreaux]] used a solder-blaster while repairing the ''[[Nighthawk]]'', a [[B-7 light freighter]] bought by Jedi [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] in a junkyard on [[Jovan Station]].<ref name="DR" />
